lines.zh: 我张开长翼，顺着山风滑。
lines.en: I spread my long wings and ride the mountain wind.

lines.zh: 我从山脊这边滑到那边。
lines.en: I glide from one ridge to the other.
My long crest cuts the wind.
I circle above the cliffs.
I rarely land. Gliding costs less.

lines.zh: 我压低翅膀，穿过一处豁口。
lines.en: I drop a wingtip and thread a gap.

lines.zh: 我贴着山坡飞，看下面的羊。
lines.en: I skim the hillside watching the sheep.
One beat lifts me two blocks.

lines.zh: 我朝山下的林地滑过去。
lines.en: I glide toward the woodland below.
I turn slowly in the rising air.

lines.zh: 我落在一块突出的岩上，再看。
lines.en: I settle on an outcrop and watch again.

lines.zh: 风把我的翼拉成一道弧。
lines.en: The wind bows my wings into an arc.
I pass through a cloud shadow.
I fly toward the sound.
I rest on a rock with my wings folded.
The mountain wind never stops.

lines.zh: 我的头冠投下一条长影。
lines.en: My crest throws a long shadow.
I watch for movement in the valley.

lines.zh: 我把翼展开一点，试了试风。
lines.en: I open one wing to test the air.
A beast crosses below.
I have no feathers, only membrane.

lines.zh: 我把脖子转过去，看背后。
lines.en: I turn my neck to look behind.

lines.zh: 岩石上有一层薄薄的苔。
lines.en: There is a thin layer of moss on the rock.
I open my jaws and the wind pours in.

lines.zh: 我在等一股上升的气流。
lines.en: I wait for a rising current.
I shift my feet slowly.
I open my jaws and shake my crest.
The wind is turning on the cliff face.
You stand on the hillside.
I saw you from above.

lines.zh: 在我的翼展下面，你很小。
lines.en: Under my wingspan you are small.

lines.zh: 我一只翼就有你两倍宽。
lines.en: One wing of mine is twice your width.

lines.zh: 你退到石头后面，也没用。
lines.en: Behind the stone will not help you.
This ridge is mine.
To go up you must pass me.

lines.zh: 我的翼一展，影子就盖住你。
lines.en: When I spread my wings my shadow covers you.
No hurry. The wind allows waiting.
I can hear your steps.
You dare look up at me. Good.

lines.zh: 你要走这条路，我在上面。
lines.en: If you take this path, I am above it.
The cut is in my left wing membrane.
I fly crooked before levelling.
I retreat to the cliff edge.
Blood drips from my wingtip.
The hit is in my wing bone. Noted.
The crest on my wing cuts the wind.

lines.zh: 我落在一块石上停了一下。
lines.en: I land on a stone and pause.
I can still fly, only slower.
I tuck the wing against my side.
It is not time to fall yet.
That is not one bite for me.
I see it. I will wait.

lines.zh: 山风把血味送进我鼻孔。
lines.en: The mountain wind brings blood to my nostrils.
Not worth descending for.
I circle once before deciding.
I caught what fell.

lines.zh: 太大的我不碰，会拖我下去。
lines.en: Too large would drag me down.
I dip my head and sniff.
That is no longer fresh.
I lift my head and still do not eat.
You hit a wing bone.
I bank and it is avoided.
I am above. You struck air.

lines.zh: 我的翼一扇，你退了半步。
lines.en: One wingbeat and you step back.
Stop throwing things upward.
I skim along the rock face.

lines.zh: 这一点碰撞，我连方向都没改。
lines.en: That did not change my heading.

lines.zh: 你碰到的只是我的影子。
lines.en: You only touched my shadow.
I go round the far side of the ridge.
Clear the way. I am coming down.

lines.zh: 山里有几只同族，飞得更高。
lines.en: There are a few of us in these hills, higher up.

lines.zh: 它们各自沿一条山脊飞。
lines.en: Each keeps to its own ridge.
We do not collide in the air.

lines.zh: 有一只总在同一块岩上歇。
lines.en: One always rests on the same rock.
Its crest is shorter than mine.

lines.zh: 我们在那片岩上方交错飞过。
lines.en: We cross above that rock.
Neither of us lands.

lines.zh: 这样飞了一阵，才算认识。
lines.en: Flying like that for a while counts as knowing.

lines.zh: 这片山脉容得下我们几只。
lines.en: These mountains hold us all.

lines.zh: 冬天来之前，都会往南去。
lines.en: Before winter we will all go south.

lines.zh: 我用爪子抓起一块骨头。
lines.en: I take up a bone in my claws.
Light enough to carry.
I take it up and fly a way.
It fell and I did not stop.
Too heavy for my grip.
Something bright in a rock crack.
I pry it loose with my beak.
That is of little use.
I drop it down the slope.
There is nothing I need to carry.
Something walks the slope.
The mountain wind lifts me above it.
It watches its feet, not the sky.
The wind favors me from here.
I aim my long beak at it.
I slide down the thermal.
It moves toward the rocks.

lines.zh: 那里有一道沟，能挡住我。
lines.en: There is a gully that can break my dive.
I ride the mountain wind higher.
It comes out of the gully.
I wait up high for the opening.
It paused on the slope, and I moved.
Wings folded, I dive straight down.
It heard the wind.
I track it along the ridge.
It keeps climbing.
I made one circle over it.

lines.zh: 它的影子把位置告诉我。
lines.en: Its shadow tells me where it is.
I drop lower and lower.
It has walked into the open.
The wind suddenly came apart.
In the turbulence I steady my wing arm.
It looked up and saw me.
It froze for an instant.
That instant is enough.
It runs, the wrong way.
Downhill is faster. For me.
My shadow falls ahead of it.
I narrow my wings further.
Its hands are up over its face.
I come back round the other side.
My claws reach it first.

lines.zh: 我的嘴前有个翘起的脊。
lines.en: A raised ridge runs along my beak.
It rolls aside and I turn with it.
My wing's edge rakes its brow.
I slam it into a boulder.
It has hold of my leg.

lines.zh: 我往上一拉，它就悬空了。
lines.en: I haul up and it leaves the ground.
My claws open and it drops down the slope.
I dive off the cliff wall again.
That lands on its chest.
I strike its waist with my crest.
It grabs my wing and tears.
I cry out and the valley rings.
It rolls down the slope.
I follow it down.
My landing is heavy.

lines.zh: 我沿着山脊的背面爬升。
lines.en: I climb along the lee side of the ridge.
The mountain wind holds me steady.
My shadow sweeps the whole slope.

lines.zh: 我先绕了一圈，看清地形。
lines.en: I circle once to read the ground.

lines.zh: 这里有一条窄路通往上面。
lines.en: A narrow way leads upward here.

lines.zh: 我的翼晾在风里，慢慢展开。
lines.en: I spread my wings into the wind.

lines.zh: 岩壁上的碎石被我带落。
lines.en: Grit falls from the cliff as I pass.
I land on the rock and fold my wings.

lines.zh: 山里的空气稀薄，很清爽。
lines.en: The mountain air is thin and clean.

lines.zh: 谷底有响动，我竖起头冠。
lines.en: Something stirs below; my crest lifts.

lines.zh: 我把头低下来，看着谷底。
lines.en: I dip my head to watch the valley floor.
This is my hour.

lines.zh: 我转了个方向，往风里去。
lines.en: I turn and head into the wind.
No other wings are in these mountains.
One beat and I am off the ground.
I fly out along the ridgeline.

lines.zh: 火烧到皮膜，我急速下落。
lines.en: Fire caught the membrane and I dropped fast.

lines.zh: 我被风甩下，砸在山坡上。
lines.en: The wind shed me and I hit the slope.

lines.zh: 水灌进嘴里，翼变得很沉。
lines.en: Water filled my mouth and my wings grew heavy.
The blast tumbled me in midair.
An arrow skimmed my wing bone.

lines.zh: 怪力把我的翼撑开，收不回来。
lines.en: Strange force spread my wing and I cannot fold it.

lines.zh: 山里没有猎物，我越来越轻。
lines.en: No prey in these hills and I grow light.

lines.zh: 雷打在翼上，我浑身一僵。
lines.en: Lightning struck my wing and I seized up.
The mountain is gone and I am falling.
